Which companies mine lithium in Zimbabwe?
Thought for 8s

The table has 1 row, for “Lithium”. Operators, as printed: Bikita Minerals (Private) Ltd.

As recorded in the USGS Minerals Yearbook 2019 (status: Sourced, a primary statistical source; company structure as of that year), the operator shown in the table below is:

Capacity is capacity, not production, and names no buyers.

According to the USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries 2026 (status: Sourced, primary statistical source), Zimbabwe's mine production for Lithium in 2025 was 28,000 t (estimated), representing a 9.7% world share and ranking 4th globally out of a world total of 290,000 t.
